Before you book

Frequently asked questions

Are the tools sterilized?

Always. Metal tools are sterilized after every client, and files and light tools are single-use and thrown away.

Where exactly are you located?

3375 Pony Trail Drive, Unit 403, Mississauga, ON L4X 1R8. A private home studio, by appointment only.

How long do lash extensions last?

Classic extensions last 4 to 6 weeks with a refill every 2 to 3 weeks. Lash clusters last about 1 to 2 weeks.

How do I care for my lashes after my appointment?

Keep them away from water and steam for the first 24 hours. After that, brush them gently every day, avoid rubbing or pulling, sleep on your back when you can, and use oil-free makeup remover. This helps them last longer.

What should I avoid after waxing?

For the first 24 hours, avoid hot showers, saunas, tight clothing, sun exposure and heavy exercise. After 2 days, start gentle exfoliation a few times a week and keep the skin moisturized to prevent ingrown hairs.

How soon will I see results from skin brightening?

Most clients notice a difference after 3 to 4 sessions. Dark areas on knees, elbows and underarms fade gradually.

Is there downtime after microneedling?

Your skin may be a little red for 1 to 2 days. We'll give you aftercare instructions and tell you what to avoid.

Can I cancel or change my appointment?

Of course. Just let us know at least 3 hours before so we can offer the slot to someone else.

How can I pay?

Cash, debit or Interac e-Transfer after your session.
